capabilities: Review selected or full-note Spanish writing with source-based AI feedback in a side pane
Build study guides limited to vocabulary and verbs above your level
Save excerpts of others' text with meaning, register, and vocabulary
Add inline translations that render as hover text in Reading view and Live Preview
Track word and verb progress through optional per-item notes with a progress property
extras: Free and open source (Apache 2.0) with extensive privacy and network disclosures; desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.5+), mobile support not yet available; hosted AI providers charge for use per their own pricing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get learner-controlled Spanish writing feedback and build study notes from text you already wrote.
